dialogues.text: Excuse me. You two are... travelers from beyond these lands, yes?
Heh... Sorry, but is this little Tepetlisaur your companion?
Even got a lovely scarf tied to his tail, I see! Haha, he sure is a little bundle of energy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yup, this is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. We met as soon as we arrived in Natlan, and he's been traveling with us since.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!
Traveling together, are you? Hmm. Well, then, forgive me for being presumptuous, but that kind of behavior is dangerous indeed...

choices.text: Traveling together with a Saurian, you mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Humans and Saurians living together is pretty normal here, isn't it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Or do you mean that traveling is dangerous, and so {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} shouldn't wander off too far?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?
#Not exactly... Travel's good for Saurians and humans alike. But if you'll forgive my bluntness, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} here is quite different.

Sorry. All this talk, and I haven't even introduced myself! Manqu's the name. I am a researcher for the Saurian Relics Association, and am responsible for scholarly inquiries into certain tribal customs...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Simply put, I study past tribal customs.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: And of course, I've heard our little Tepetlisaur's name. May I have yours too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #Ah, such energy. Looks like {NICKNAME} and Paimon have been taking good care of you...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err... Err?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Of course we have! We've feasted a ton in our time together, haven't we, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, don't go wandering off!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Shame. He's such a vigorous little one too...

choices.text: So, what's the danger exactly?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: My apologies. Eloquence is not my strong suit... But I really do think it is a shame.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #Alright. I'll be forthright. You must have seen many little Tepetlisaurs before, yes? {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is different from them.

choices.text: Yeah, he has a beautiful ribbon on his tail!

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Haha, that was your doing, no? But that's not what I'm talking about — rather, I speak of the mark on his horn.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: That is not a mark that an ordinary Saurian would bear. In truth, records indicate this to be the "Flame{RUBY#[D]Xiuhcoatl}lord's Blessing."

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: How to put it... Saurians with this mark often possess incredible power, such as greater strength than other Saurians, swifter swimming speed, or being able to leap to greater heights.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds like a perk to me.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: But as I said before, this is a blessing from the Flamelord, and not their own power.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: This is the power of the far more ancient dragons, and Natlan's Saurians can no longer withstand it today.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: The Wayob and the Night Kingdom also reject this power, and as such, refuse to accept such Saurians.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: And in the process of growing, they will sometimes be killed by this power, or driven mad by it... Both dangerous possibilities.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Perhaps, I believe, you should deliver him to the Children of Echoes. They will deal with the matter appropriately.

choices.text: "Deal with the matter"?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Again, apologies for my clumsy words. But I believe it best to leave this to us locals.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Thanks for letting me know.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: But you do not intend to give up on him, I presume?

choices.text: Giving up should never be the first resort.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: ...*sigh* Alright. Very well, outlander. Your resolve is evident.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: I do not know if I should reveal this to you, for this is a secret that only we locals know...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: #...But if you wish to save {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you must take him on a pilgrimage to the volcano.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Legend has it that our tribal warriors would carry a token that was split in two, and in the great volcano they would wash the name of their companion as remembered by the Fallen {RUBY#[D]Xiuhcoatl}Dragon.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Then, they would gain their Saurian the Night Kingdom's acceptance once more.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why are you telling me this?

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Because the people of the six great tribes no longer attempt this, nor have they the time to spare for such an attempt.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: But you are an outlander, a traveler from afar, unbound by the old-fashioned ideas the tribes hold.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: And if you succeed, you will prove beyond doubt that the inscriptions on some ancient relics and crumbling scrolls remain true to this day.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: This is of utmost importance to me... so if you would like to try, I will help you find that token.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: And as for you, you will be able to save your companion.

choices.text: Sounds like a win-win.

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: In that case, I shall let you know if I find the place. Alternatively, you could come find me. My research will take me near the Children of Echoes for the time being...

response.speaker: Manqu
response.text: Until we meet again, then, friend.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The Saurian Relics Association member, Manqu, turns and departs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, hey! {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! Quit running around already!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, and by the way, {NICKNAME}, is that guy gone? He didn't say anything weird, did he?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Long story short...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... In other words, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is sick, and we need to grab some stuff and take him up the volcano to get that illness cured...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Not that he seems to understand anything that's going on, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not that it matters. Maybe we'll solve all the problems before he gets big. That way, there'll be nothing standing between him and growing up healthy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now, we can't be sure if we can rely on that guy... But if it's a token we need, we can look around too, can't we? Who knows, we might find it even faster!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Err?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You come along too!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: It's worth a shot...
I do not abandon my companions.
That phrasing is ice-cold.
You mean the red mark on his horn?
Mind your tone, would you?
Don't worry, I've been careful not to get eaten...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #C'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} wouldn't do that to you!
